summary: Re-rendered PLAN.md/CLARIFICATIONS.md. Appended 4 entries to decisions.md from the step's envelopes and the plan's own decisions[]/amendments[]: the two decision-tree-grounded technology choices (D1, D2) and the two in-flight corrections the plan-verifier made before the build ran (adding admin/flow-for-admins for the emailSimple shape; removing the inapplicable check_email_templates.py test). Wrote one traceability.md row (REQ-001) joining the requirement to M1-S01's artefacts and test results, status In UAT pending the milestone's own post-deploy manual test. Skipped the ten-section configuration workbook: standards/build-orchestration.md Section 3.1 marks it optional at scale: feature (only traceability.md is required), and this build's single Flow step would populate one workbook section (6 - Automation) while leaving nine empty -- recorded the skip explicitly in traceability.md and here rather than silently omitting it. Set M1-S01 to documented.
confidence_rationale: The one requirement this step serves has a traceability row with a real source (the fit_gap entry) and a stated verification path (the checker plus the milestone's manual test); every decision recorded traces to an envelope or the plan's own decisions[]/amendments[] rather than being narrated; re-running this step's documentation would produce byte-identical rows (workbook step skipped by contract, not by omission).

process_observations.observation: Both plan-verifier corrections (D1/D2 aside, the two 'deviation' entries) were fully traceable back to the step's own amendments[] array on plan.json, so decisions.md did not need to reconstruct them from memory or from the verification envelope's prose alone.

Whether the workbook-optional rule at scale:feature means 'skip it' or 'write a one-section workbook and mark the other nine as not applicable' is a judgment call standards/build-orchestration.md Section 3.1 does not fully resolve (its ask-scale carve-out explicitly redirects rows to RUN.md; feature scale's carve-out is only 'optional', with no stated alternative destination). Chose to skip entirely and rely on traceability.md + decisions.md + PLAN.md, on the reasoning that a nine-empty-section workbook for a one-step build documents nothing a reader could not already see in PLAN.md.
M1-S01 is documented, the only step in milestone M1; the milestone is ready for cross-step verification and the acceptance report.
process_observations.followup_reason: standards/build-orchestration.md Section 3 routes a milestone whose every step is documented to milestone-verifier next.

citations.used_for: Section 3.1 feature-scale documentation rule (workbook optional, traceability required)

followups.because: M1's only step is now documented

extensions.workbook_skipped_reason: scale: feature marks the workbook optional per standards/build-orchestration.md Section 3.1; traceability.md and decisions.md carry the requirement-to-delivery join for this single-step build instead
